rules: Sources import as 'Awaiting source verification'; no legal determination is made.
Collection authorisation fields are left blank for the compliance lead to set.
No requirements are proposed in this pack.
Every URL here appeared in search results; none has been opened or retrieval-tested.
coverage_gaps: Nigeria: a Mondaq article suggests the NLRC's role may now be limited to the FCT; this is unchecked and affects which regulator matters. Needs a legal check.

Germany: GlüStV 2021 reportedly expires 31 Dec 2028 and is under evaluation, with stake limits eased from 1 Jul 2026 (trade source, unverified). A source for the evaluation/successor treaty is missing.
Netherlands: confirm the Regeling kansspelen op afstand and Besluit kansspelen op afstand consolidated texts are held on wetten.overheid.nl; replace the vLex source with an official one.

Canada (Rest of): British Columbia's new Gaming Control Act (in force 13 Apr 2026, per trade press) has a source; no official regulator page for BC's renamed Independent Gambling Control Office, Manitoba, Saskatchewan, Quebec or Atlantic provinces was found.
Spain, Switzerland, Belgium, Italy, Portugal, Serbia, Croatia, Estonia, Latvia, Colombia, Mexico, Bosnia: not yet audited.

sources.notes: NLRC General Guidelines: licence classes, application fees, documents. Appears on the NLRC's current site nlrc-gov.ng; the existing lro.abj.gov.ng source may be an older host of the same guidelines, so compare before keeping both.
NLRC announcement of the Remote/Offshore Operator Permit (ROP), dated Aug 2024 on the NLRC site. Relevant to offshore suppliers/operators. Not yet read in full.
GGL interpretation notes on the GlüStV 2021 for virtual slot games (file dated 9 Sep 2024). Not read in full; check whether a newer version supersedes it.
GGL leaflet on applications for permission for individual virtual slot games (file dated 30 Dec 2024): game requirements and application route.
GGL leaflet on operator permission for virtual slots (file dated 8 Jan 2025). Operator-level; included for the two-step permission structure.

sources.authority: Dirección General de Ordenación del Juego (DGOJ) via BOE
sources.notes: BOE-A-2024-12639: DGOJ resolution (6 Jun 2024) approving the monitoring-system data model and amending annexes of two earlier technical-specification resolutions. Not read in full; confirm which resolutions it amends against the sources already held.

sources.authority: Dirección General de Ordenación del Juego (DGOJ)
sources.notes: DGOJ-hosted copy of the 6 Jun 2024 resolution. Possible duplicate of the BOE entry above; keep whichever the compliance lead prefers as the primary.
Real Decreto 958/2020 on commercial communications of gambling activities (BOE 4 Nov 2020). Advertising rules; add only if advertising is in scope for the baseline.
KSA Keuringsschema 2.1 (conformity assessment schema for remote gambling game systems); revision note dated Oct 2024. Check for a later version.
AGLC iGaming registration guide (operators and suppliers). Alberta sits within 'Canada (Rest of)' in the hub; trade press reports its regulated market launched 13 Jul 2026, but confirm on AGLC pages.

sources.authority: Government of Alberta (Service Alberta and Red Tape Reduction)
sources.notes: Alberta government fact sheet (13 Jan 2026) describing the iGaming Alberta Act, the Jan 2026 regulation amendments and AGLC standards.
